scientific_integrity: Analytic proof in RESULT.md with independent symbolic and numerical reproducibility checks. General literature coverage is bounded, and an equivalent specialized design might exist.
scientific_limitations: Consistent normalized rows; fixed iid sampling; only single-step sharp worst-direction conditional squared-error bound, not exact multi-step MSE; coupling 0<c<=specified feasibility threshold; no uniqueness claim for nonsymmetric optimizers; no independent audit.
title: Exact optimal randomized row sampling with a pooled measurement in an augmented star system
